name: How do waterfront property values compare to non-waterfront properties in areas like Aventura or Boca Raton?

mainEntity.name: How do waterfront property values compare to non-waterfront properties in areas like Aventura or Boca Raton?

acceptedAnswer.text: Waterfront properties generally command a premium over comparable non-waterfront properties due to their unique appeal, limited supply, and desirable views or access. In locations like Aventura or Boca Raton, this premium can vary significantly based on factors such as water body (ocean, bay, canal), direct access to open water, and the condition of existing marine infrastructure like docks or seawalls. A key decision factor in assessing value is the type of water frontage and its utility.
acceptedAnswer.description: Waterfront properties typically have higher values than non-waterfront ones due to unique appeal and limited supply. The specific type of water frontage and its utility significantly influence this premium.
